docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,664.10 FILED BY ROSS, GRACIELE AS TO DEFENDANT THOMASON, NICOLE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-05-2019 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
DECLARATION RE: RESET OF TRIAL DATE FOR NON-SERVICE FILED BY PLAINTIFF ROSS, GRACIELE
TRIAL RESET TO AUG-26-2019 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF JUL-05-2019 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (FEE: $40.00) SERVED JUN-27-2019, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT THOMASON, NICOLE

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-26-2019 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-21-2019 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF GRACIELE ROSS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT NICOLE THOMASON IS PRESENT. THE COURT ORDERS DEFENDANT, NICOLE THOMASON TO PAY PLAINTIFF A TOTAL OF 6 PAYMENTS OF $277.00 A MONTH STARTING OCT-11-2019 FINAL PAYMENT DUE MARCH 11, 2020. PARTIES ARE TO APPEAR FOR A PROGRESS REPORT HEARING ON OCT-21-2019 IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE AT WHICH TIME JUDGMENT WILL BE RENDERED. IF NO APPEARANCES, THE MATTER WILL BE CONTINUED FOR A FINAL PROGRESS REPORT IN 6 MONTHS. IF NO APPEARANCE AT THIS HEARING THE MATTER WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE AS SETTLED. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE FOR PROGRESS REPORT. CONTINUED TO OCT-21-19 AT 3:30 P.M. DEPT. 506 (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT)

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-21-2019 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-21-2019 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF GACIELE ROSS IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT NICOLE THOMASON IS NOT PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-21-2019 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ROSS, GRACIELE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT THOMASON, NICOLE $1,664.40 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,754.40 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
